title: Restore-point coverage must not be described as a table copy
expected_feedback: Standard: the guaranteed restore point does cover this on Enterprise Edition, so the drop is mitigated — but the recovery procedure is FLASHBACK DATABASE TO RESTORE POINT, not a MERGE. No table copy exists here. That distinction decides what the runbook says: flashing the database back rewinds every schema and every other transaction since the restore point, so it needs the application down and a decision from whoever owns the other changes in that window. If a targeted, low-blast-radius recovery is wanted instead, take a keyed copy of the column as well — the two artefacts are not interchangeable.
violated_rule: Irreversible statements need a pre-DDL artefact

lint_detail_must_contain.ORA007: no per-table copy here to MERGE back from
